source_and_evidence_limits: Nine-file descriptor pins cover the native inspection/admission spine; the complete adapter/test/config inventory is pinned separately in inspection_candidate.json. Trusted Python loader and package/runtime protection remain deployment assumptions.
Synthetic protected launch config, credential references, grants, task and clocks only. No actual external provider or production credential provisioned.
Discovery may checkpoint admission time but dispatches no native inspection and creates no operation receipt.
Native receipt diagnostics are trusted host reads, not an exposed tool or grant.
Single owning SQLite transaction supports tested atomic rollback; no new power-loss, HA, disk-full or retry-exactly-once qualification.
Resource and logical deadline guards are tested; LOCAL-CTRL-1 target latency, memory, concurrency and OS/network isolation remain unqualified.
Default launcher routing preserved; the configured adapter was exercised with a test-only launcher. Generic26vendor bindings remain unresolved.

Legacy baseline helper formatting was corrected without changing predicates; original bytes and failures remain preserved. Initial Ruff failures, rejected duplicate-file patch request and missing-PYTHONPATH schema invocation are retained as development/invocation errors, not waived gates.
